title: More ornament

nodes.title: Slide
nodes.body: The pitch moves and arrives. Lift the finger off the hole by degrees, more often upward, one step of the scale to the next. Downward, close the hole below and slide off it onto the note you meant. A jump is not a slide. If the contour is messy, nothing is said.

nodes.title: Cran
nodes.body: On low D: several cuts in a row. Lift and replace the third finger, then the next, then the next, then the third again. The note is still D. It is quick, and it takes time. Demonstrated before it is asked. Silence is allowed.

nodes.title: Double tap
nodes.body: Coming down to the next note, the finger that arrives bounces: down, up, down, too short to hum. If it is unclear, the loop stays quiet.

nodes.title: Triplet
nodes.body: Three notes in the time of one, then you are back. The detector may abstain.

nodes.title: Vibrato
nodes.body: A small fast wobble in the pitch. A finger waving over an open hole, not closing it, is the light way. The air can do it too, from below the lungs, and that one is bigger. You can name it. The app almost never remarks on it.

source: Gestures named for this pack. Each is demonstrated, then asked. The detector may stay silent. Vibrato is named and almost never remarked on.
